title: 逆転裁判4
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

The table: the card's whole font (1,817 characters) read in code order, kanji by manga-ocr and by one reader on sheets beside the OCR's readings (377 corrected); the card's whole script read through in sentences with it
notes: Read by the script games/nds/AGCJ.lua. The section of the script being played lies unpacked in main memory; a word says where it has got to. A page is said when that stands on a wait. Who speaks is given as the script's number for the speaker only. Not looked at: choices, the court record, cross-examination, saved games. The id AGCJ is the card's game code.
